response.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT s.telescref, o.weathprofile, s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation), base AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS b FROM linked), grp AS (SELECT telescref, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase FROM linked GROUP BY telescref, weathprofile) SELECT g.weathprofile, AVG(g.avg_mod) AS avg_modindex, AVG(g.avg_phase) AS avg_phaseshift, AVG(g.avg_mod - base.b) AS avg_excess_over_baseline FROM grp g CROSS JOIN base WHERE g.avg_mod > base.b GROUP BY g.weathprofile

assumptions.assumption: Linking uses inner joins signals→telescopes→observatories, so signals with no matching telescope or observatory are dropped.

The baseline is the plain average of modindex over all linked signals (each signal weighted equally), ignoring NULL modindex values; AVG ignores NULLs in the group averages too, and groups with NULL average modindex are not kept.
Each weather profile's output averages are unweighted means over the kept telescope groups (each group counts equally, not weighted by signal count).
